newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR STARTS THURSDAY LARGELY EASIER.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR STARTS THURSDAY LARGELY EASIER.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted easier on most hard currencies in early Thursday's interbank trading session.
"The interbank market is still very quiet but we've seen some movement here and there," one foreign exchange dealer commented.
The dealers said the market was likely to be uneventful the rest of the day, with the local unit expected to hold largely steady at its current levels.

At around 0755 GMT, the Zimbabwe dollar was trading at 11.3000/3100 against the U.S. dollar from 11.2960/3060 at Wednesday's close and was also quoted weaker against sterling at 18.4285/4395 compared to 18.4015/4230.
It was at 6.5380/5460 from 6.53005/5325 versus the mark but was a touch firmer against South Africa's rand at 2.5245/5265 compared to 2.5270/5280.
